title: Logical Model Enumeration Schema
description: JSON Schema defining the structure of the Logical Model enumeration endpoint response

url.description: Relative URL to the schema file

logicalModelUrl.description: FHIR canonical URL of the Logical Model

propertyCount.description: Number of properties in the Logical Model

schemas.title: TD.J1 Birth-dose DVC
schemas.description: What the birth hospital records for each birth dose and signs into one Digital Vaccination Certificate (DVC, an HCERT) per dose: the payload, the CWT claims and the key that signs it.

schemas.title: TD.J2B Referral for verification
schemas.description: The community health worker's referral of the child to the home clinic, to verify the foreign cards and fit the doses to the national schedule.

schemas.title: TD.J2A Newborn registration on a home visit
schemas.description: What the community health worker records offline when she finds a newborn missing from the household roster: the registration form's answers and each dose read from a foreign card without verifying it.

schemas.title: TD.J3A DVC verification and import
schemas.description: What the clinic records when it verifies a foreign DVC against its cached copy of the trust list, and, when the DVC verifies, imports the dose in place of the reported one.

schemas.title: TD.J3B Imported dose and schedule
schemas.description: What the clinic records for each imported dose's vaccine code, and what the national schedule finds due once the doses are counted.

schemas.title: TD.J41 Access to a shared link
schemas.description: What the home country logs for every request to open a shared link, released or refused.

schemas.title: TD.J40 Shared link and consent
schemas.description: What the home country records when the holder shares a family member's summary as a Verifiable Health Link (VHL): who may read what, for how long, and that a passcode protects it.
